summary.text: Chad Koppie, a Republican former Delta Air Lines jet captain and farmer, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the open U.S. House seat in Illinois's 7th District to La Shawn Ford.

He has served on local school boards and as a township trustee, has run for office repeatedly, and was the Republican candidate in this district in 2022 and 2024 before winning the March 2026 primary over Patricia Easley, 65% to 35%.

paragraphs.text: Koppie attended aviation school at Purdue University and worked as a jet captain with Delta Airlines and as a farmer; Ballotpedia lists his profession as farmer.
He has served as a member of the Kane County Regional Board of Schools, a board member of the Illinois Forum, a township trustee and a local school board member.

Koppie was chosen at the Constitution Party's March 2018 nominating convention as its lieutenant gubernatorial nominee, and Ballotpedia lists him as a Constitution Party candidate for U.S. Senate in 2020.
In 2022 he ran in the Republican primary for Illinois' 8th District, which Chris Dargis won, and was a candidate in the 2022 general election in the 7th District, which Rep. Danny K. Davis won.
He was the unopposed Republican primary winner in March 2024 and received 16.7% of the vote against Davis in the November 2024 general election.
Koppie won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary over Patricia Easley and was on the November 3, 2026 ballot for the open seat.
He received 10.8% of the vote to La Shawn Ford's 89.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
